proposed_by: Claude Fable 5.1, deep-coder subagent of session a49e1cd3, 2026-10-22, from the first source XML of each pair
scope: The 25 non-Exxon two-file pairs of modern_nonexxon_pairs25.json (ADR 0015), keyed by the first source id of each pair, which is the id modern_bulk.resource_types() looks up for a pair record.
rule: dataset: the entry describes data (survey, cruise, catch, tagging, monitoring data, a database, time series, model output, gridded or satellite products, a data collection). publication-report: the entry describes a document (report, proceedings, workshop report, journal article, thesis, book or chapter, newsletter, bulletin, radio-show script, bibliography, progress report, proposal). A report that mainly presents data is a report when the entry describes the publication; data documented in a report is a dataset when the entry describes the data.
decision: Brett Johnson, 2026-10-20 (question 4 of the v2 mapping questions): each record is typed Dataset or Publication>Report by AI classification of what the catalogue entry describes.
merge: Not read by any runtime. After review, `types` is merged into docs/readiness/2026-10-22/resource_types_r4.json, built from r3, and its SHA256 is pinned in modern_bulk.RESOURCE_TYPES_SHA; until then a v2 wire for these pairs holds with "no reviewed resource type".
